newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil coffee coop stocks 1.49 mln bags end-March.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee coop stocks 1.49 mln bags end-March.

text.p: Coffee stocks held by Brazilian cooperatives totaled 1.49 million 60.5-kg bags on March 31, National Coffee Council (CNC) said in a statement.
That is down from than the 2.07 million bags held by cooperatives as of Feb 28 and also below the 1.75 million bags held at the same stage in 1996.
That stocks are lower at this stage than last year when producers were working with the frost and drought-hit 1995/96 crop shows the higher level of sales by producers, CNC said.

Sales by cooperatives reached 731,919 bags in March versus 748,812 bags during February and 481,479 bags in March last year, showing that producers maintained the flow of coffee to the market, the CNC said.

Cooperatives received 150,942 bags of coffee during the month of March, almost exactly twice the 78,373 bags delivered in March 1996, but down from the 182,287 bags delivered in February, it added. ((-Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151))
